member.name: M:ParrotCode.Platforms.ProjectBackupCommandLineExecutable.Execute
member.summary: Executes a Robocopy command that creates a temporary backup of the current Unity project before the build process begins.
member.remarks:
The method copies the root project directory to the temporary build project directory using the predefined Robocopy arguments in .
A directory for the Robocopy log file is created automatically if it does not already exist.
The command is executed asynchronously through and returns the Robocopy exit code when the copy operation completes.
member.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains the exit code returned by Robocopy.
member.exception: Thrown if the Robocopy process fails to complete successfully.
Thrown if the Robocopy process could not be started.
